entries.325cddcae46b54f6: Its mission is 'Let possibilities take flight' and its vision is 'Create a world where strengths shine.' It states that it will polish its education expertise to maintain the value of its education-integrated placement services, and that it will respond both to job-seeker support regardless of place of residence through online delivery and to face-to-face opportunities such as joint company information sessions. It states that, through stronger sales efforts to develop job openings and create more employment, it aims to keep contributing from recruitment through retention and success, and to increase cumulative sales per client. For the trends toward career autonomy and human capital management, it states that it will respond on a group-wide basis by making use of platforms such as the career interview platform of a consolidated subsidiary.

entries.ee53a6c6529dc33a: Its feature is the combination of education and placement. Drawing on the training know-how it has built up for companies, the company has job seekers take a free job-search course before introducing them to companies, which allows it to specialize in talent groups such as freeters and university dropouts who are at a disadvantage in the hiring market. Group interview sessions in which job seekers and companies interview each other on a round-robin basis, and support for retention and success through training running from before joining until one year after joining, are also mechanisms that general placement services do not have.
